text:
It's 7 a.m. You hit snooze. Phone in hand. You already feel behind, and you call that anxiety.

It is not anxiety. It is practice.

Two emotions cannot share your head at once. The one you feed first wins the day. Every morning you feed fear without thinking.

Name that. The morning download.

21 seconds before your phone. Eyes open. One deliberate feeling. Hold it.

30 days. Fear stops arriving first.

You were not born anxious. You practiced your way here. Practice your way out.
caption:
Discipline and self improvement start before you even check your phone. Your mindset is decided in the first 60 seconds you are awake.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
